facts.business: IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd is India's first Integrated Multi-National Transport Infrastructure Developer in Roads & Highways segment, operating as a Sponsor and Operations & Maintenance-led infrastructure platform with focus on capital efficiency, recurring cash flows, long-term annuity income and sustainable shareholder returns.

segments.name: BOT assets and projects under construction

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex of projects through sub-ordinated debt
Repayment of indebtedness (external secured debt) used for capital expenditure
Repayment of indebtedness (Related party loans) used for capital expenditure

guidance_or_targets.statement: IRB aims to expand its asset base under management to approximately Rs 1.40 lakh crore over the next three to four years, while further strengthening recurring cash flows, long-term annuity income and sustainable shareholder returns.

key_risks: Private sector participation remains uneven, particularly in greenfield and high-risk projects
Risk allocation, traffic uncertainty, and legacy issues have constrained broader private capital inflows
Rising costs of key inputs such as steel, cement, and bitumen, along with fuel price volatility, have increased project costs and impacted contractor margins
Heightened risk in respect of the impairment of loans granted to related parties and joint ventures
Judgment involved on impairment of loans and other receivables dependent on number of infrastructure projects being completed as per schedule timelines and generation of future cash flows
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances & investments with related parties; Repayment of indebtedness (Related party loans) used for capital expenditure of Rs 5,175.01 crore in FY26; Impairment assessment of loans granted to related parties and joint ventures
